title: Quote of the Day by Voltaire: "If you want to know who controls you, look at who you are not allowed to..."
summary: Voltaire's quote urges independent thought and warns that genuine power is revealed by who cannot be criticized. The short piece encourages questioning authority, defending free speech, valuing honest criticism, and applying Enlightenment principles of courage, integrity and critical thinking to modern life.
content:
Today's quote of the day by Voltaire is a timeless reminder that freedom begins with the courage to think independently. His words challenge us to question power, value honest criticism, and protect free speech without fear. The quote still speaks to modern life, offering practical lessons on critical thinking, integrity, personal freedom, and the importance of standing up for the truth.
